items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: my sister Josephine married a saxophone player named Bill Shine. Fantastic lead alto man.

ctx.x: My father played banjo and guitar, my mother played guitar, I had two brothers and two sisters. My brother Teddy was a piano player, my brother Andy was a drummer, both of my sisters were singers. My sister Margaret married a piano player named Shorty Allen, and my sister Josephine married a saxophone player named Bill Shine. Fantastic lead alto man. And my grandfather, my father’s father, played guitar, and my aunt — he was living with his daughter Josephine until he died, and she says the day he died he was…
